data.name: Sophia
data.gender_notes: Sophia is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek sophia, 'wisdom'. Its root is Greek sophia (σοφία). A Christian virtue name; Hagia Sophia means 'Holy Wisdom'. Sophia is a Greek name meaning “Wisdom”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sophia expresses “Wisdom”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sophia total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
